desc: A score with shifting sections and a chaotic movement -- in a single match, Pokemon are split into three deployment groups of 1, 2, and 3 units respectively. When one side's current group is defeated, the next group takes the field. The battle ends once one side has claimed two victories.
name: Segmented Movement

desc: A lofty score with a thunderous movement -- the team may only deploy Epic or Mythic Pokemon, with no other restrictions.
name: War of the Gods

desc: A blended score with a harmonious movement -- the team may only deploy lineups containing at least 4 dual-type Pokemon, with no other restrictions.
name: Elemental Ensemble

desc: A strict score with an orderly movement -- the lineup has demanding type requirements: deploy 2 Ice- or Dragon-type Pokemon, plus 1 additional Water-type Pokemon.
name: Elemental Counterpoint

desc: A strict score with an orderly movement -- the lineup has demanding type requirements: deploy 3 Bug- or Fairy-type Pokemon, plus 2 additional Fire- or Grass-type Pokemon.
name: Elemental Counterpoint

desc: A pure score with a gentle movement -- the team may only deploy mono-type Pokemon, with no other restrictions.
name: Elemental Solo
